title: Grounds for Denial and Denial Review — Medical Records Requests
content:
**§1 Grounds without review.** A request under Medical Records Requests may be denied without review for psychotherapy notes or for information compiled for litigation.

**§2 Reviewable ground.** A request may be denied on a reviewable ground when a licensed professional determines that release is reasonably likely to endanger the life or physical safety of the patient or another person.

**§3 Review.** Where the request type makes denial review available, the requester may ask for a review of a reviewable denial by a licensed professional who did not take part in the denial, completed within the type's denial review period in calendar days.

**§4 Third-party requests without authorization.** A third-party request without a valid authorization is denied, unless — on a request type that requires a court subpoena or order when no patient authorization is given — a court subpoena or order is served.

**§5 Fee at denial.** A denied request's outstanding fee is waived.

A request may be denied before compilation, or, in part or in whole, on a ground found during review of the records in process.

## Grounds compared

| Ground | Reviewable? | Review available when |
|---|---|---|
| Psychotherapy notes | No | — |
| Information compiled for litigation | No | — |
| A licensed professional determines release is reasonably likely to endanger the life or physical safety of the patient or another person | Yes | The request type makes denial review available; the review is by a licensed professional who did not take part, within the type's review period |

## Third-party requests without a valid authorization

| Type requires a court subpoena or order when no patient authorization is given | Court subpoena or order served | Outcome on the missing authorization |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | Yes | Not denied on this ground |
| Yes | No | Denied |
| No | Either | Denied |

## Illustrations (hypothetical)

- A request is denied because a licensed professional determines release is reasonably likely to endanger another person's physical safety, on a type making review available. The requester may ask for review; it is carried out by a licensed professional who took no part in the denial and is completed within the type's review period.
- The material asked for is information compiled for litigation. The request may be denied on that ground without review.
- A denied request had a fee of a hypothetical $18.00 outstanding. The $18.00 is waived.
